runtime_observations: Google Forms controls are ARIA divs, not native inputs (except text/email/textarea); use aria-checked to verify.
Yes/No and single-answer questions may be implemented as checkboxes allowing multiple selections; enforce single choice by semantics.
Question text is the [role=heading] inside each [role=listitem]; options carry aria-label.

Options are aria-labelled divs. Page 2+ unknown. Never press Next/Submit in prepare-only mode.
